resources.string:
How Supra uses Health Connect

Supra reads only the health data you allow (activity, calories burned, exercise, sleep, resting heart rate, weight, water and nutrition) and only when one of your Supra apps asks for it and you approved that app.

Supra writes only what you log yourself: meals, weight and water.

Readings stay on this phone and your own Supra server. They are never sent to anyone else, never used for advertising, and never written to logs.

You can change or revoke access any time in Health Connect, or in Supra → Settings → Permissions.
